Subject: MAP handoff and decision timeline - HealthLynx pilot

Hi Ava and Trent —

Thanks again for running the demo last week. As discussed with Ava, I’m putting together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align on objectives, decision criteria, and a target close/pilot timeline so we can keep momentum. The goal of this thread is to: 1) confirm the success criteria for the pilot, 2) identify internal stakeholders and owners at HealthLynx, and 3) agree on the milestone dates for evaluation and procurement.

High-level proposed goals (please confirm/edit):
- Pilot scope: ingest anonymized claims and clinical notes for a 30-day evaluation focused on extraction accuracy and inference latency at 95th percentile.
- Success criteria: >= 92% entity-extraction F1 on the validation set; end-to-end P99 latency < 600ms for single-request inference; no data leaves the VPC.
- Decision: move to a 6-month dedicated deployment if criteria met and procurement signs off.

Proposed timeline (open to adjustments):
- Week 0 (this week): Align stakeholders + share MAP (attached).
- Week 1: Technical kickoff & test data handoff.
- Weeks 2-5: Pilot runs + weekly syncs.
- Week 6: Pilot review + procurement discussion.

Action items for you, Ava: can you confirm the internal champion list (who will do the acceptance testing), and the procurement/IT contacts we should loop in? Trent — if you’re the procurement contact, can you confirm expected steps on your side and any procurement windows we should be aware of?

I’ve attached a draft MAP and a short pilot scope doc. I’ll schedule a 30-minute alignment call for early next week unless you prefer otherwise.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
